title: Drinking in the family
summary: Jelly did not drink, and her grandmother's sons seldom did either.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Would you like to have a drink now?

No, no, I think we're just about another two or three minutes on here. I'm trying to think if there's anything else to ask you about in Chicago. But you should be dry, my goodness. No, I don't. When I get up in the morning, I drink a couple of glasses of fruit juice, and then I don't get thirsty for a while.
It's best for you not to drink soft drinks anyway.
No, I don't drink much Coke now. People say your brother never did drink either, you know, which is unusual for musicians, because a lot of musicians, you know...

Well, you'd be surprised, my grandmother with all those sons. I mean, she never had a drunken... Just the last young son stopped drinking after he lost his first wife, because he'd been married three times before he had... He had nine children with one woman, seven with another. I don't know how many he had in Chicago. But all of her children had a lot of children, but the only one in the family had one child.
So I guess your brother never did really drink much at all, that I ever heard of.
No, and I mean, he didn't have a lot of drinks around. You know how later on in life people made homebrew and all that.
I never thought I'd got liquor, no. No, I don't think he ever did that.
Didn't have any liquor around our house like that. He was a wonderful mayor...
